title: Setting the Payment a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan Bills Each Cycle
content:
# Setting the Payment a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans Bills Each Cycle

**Finance desk servicing rule.** The payment a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan bills each cycle stands on the plan record and can be set to a rebuilt figure. Writing that figure replaces whatever the plan was billing before, and the plan bills it from the next cycle onward; nothing else about the plan moves, its standing, its balance and its promotional term being untouched, and no entry is booked to the billing history. Afterwards the customer sees the new payment on the plan and on the next statement.

## Conditions on the figure

The rebuilt payment is fixed only after every billing cycle the plan has closed carries in the billing history the statement that cycle presented.

Before the rebuilt payment is worked out, every lateness charge the plan carries that a failure of the chain's own handling brought about must already stand answered by a give-back in the billing history.

## Invoking `update_scheduled_payment_2c04479a`

The agent unlocks `update_scheduled_payment_2c04479a` and calls it. One call sets the payment on one plan.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `financing_plan_id` | The reference number of the promotional financing plan record whose billed payment is being set | An identifier, read from the financing plan lookup for this customer before the call |
| `rebuilt_monthly_payment` | The payment the plan is to bill each cycle | In USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, half-up at the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; an empty value is not accepted |

**Return.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the plan reference and the payment now standing on it in USD to two decimal places. That sentence naming the new payment is what indicates the plan record now bills that figure.

## Points of judgement

- The call writes the figure it is given; the figure itself is worked out from the plan's records and this desk's published rules before the call.
- The figure replaces what the plan was billing; the plan record holds one billed payment, not a history of them.
